tradeoff.development_decision: Do not promote period 3 as the default: fewer subscription scans but negligible total summary payload saving and additional search work; end-to-end benefit is unmeasured on this fixed development cohort.

implementation: Per-lane per-die subscribed summary caches persist across proposals. Explicit 64-byte cold fetch/reply and changed-only publication frames; generation/version receiver checks. Commit validates actual consumed summaries in addition to snapshot read footprints. Forced refresh precedes replay and all caches drain at repetition end.
limitations: Asynchronous authority writers or physical network delivery
HBM mapping, migration, latency or energy
next_work: Use measured communication/replay tradeoffs to choose development scheduling/publication policies; implement HBM-resident owner/summary storage and hardware message queues, migration/topology ablations and representative physical QoR.
